name: obsidian-narrative-lab
description: Unified narrative database and canvas workspace for Obsidian

scripts.build: npm run bundle:canvas && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/project-bundle-validation.test.mjs tests/library-category-transactions.test.mjs tests/project-library-defaults.test.mjs tests/canvas-ui-mode.test.mjs tests/native-canvas-projection.test.mjs tests/data-safety-regressions.test.mjs tests/library-entity-name.test.mjs tests/story-graph-edges.test.mjs tests/library-base-consolidation.test.mjs tests/binder-note-scene-convert.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run audit:i18n && npm run test:unit && node scripts/check-release.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
